name: Frozen Greater Permafrost · Fire
primary:
A projectile flies in an arc where you look and strikes the first target. Effects:
• Damage 2.25 ❤ earth + 2 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet, earth ×2 on frozen)
• Cold 216: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Knockback
• Breaks up to 8 blocks within 0.72 blocks (twice as many if brittle)
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
self_description:
On you:
• Cold 216: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Stone skin (Resistance I) for 10.5 s
• Slowness I for 8.25 s
• Heat: sets on fire for 4.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
